nodes.title: Assert main branch after merge ops
Assert main branch at pipeline start
Cleanup failed merge state
nodes.prompt:
# hatch:no-inline-script-ok
git -C "${merge_worktree_dir}" merge --abort >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
git -C "${merge_worktree_dir}" rebase --abort >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

nodes.title: Clear stale impl_result before next iteration
Close milestone
nodes.prompt:
# hatch:no-inline-script-ok
gh api repos/${gh_repo}/milestones --state open --jq '.[] | select(.title=="${milestone_title}") | .number' | xargs -I{} gh api -X PATCH repos/${gh_repo}/milestones/{} -f state=closed >/dev/null

nodes.title: Normalize judge decision with deterministic fallback
Init shared agent sessions for wave
Post-merge judge
nodes.prompt:
You are the post-merge judge for ${gh_repo}.

Survey the existing scenario registry and use zero, one, or at most two scenarios only when they materially sharpen judgment for this merged wave. Scenarios are optional and sparse; do not force them.
Treat scenarios as high-value judgment aids, not exhaustive checklists.
Do NOT reveal or quote any scenario. Provide a redacted verdict envelope.

Merge metadata:
${merged_results}

Implementation results (per-issue review status and evidence):
${impl_results}

Merge diff summary:
${merge_stdout}

Return JSON:
{
  "schema": "verdict/v1",
  "verdict_kind": "post_merge_judge",
  "disposition": "approve|reject|defer|escalate",
  "confidence": "high|medium|low",
  "recommended_transition": "close_milestone|open_followup|request_more_evidence|escalate_contract",
  "observation": {
    "alignment_score": 0.0,
    "constraint_violations": [],
    "missing_evidence": []
  },
  "recommendation": {
    "action": "close_milestone|open_followup|request_more_evidence|escalate_contract",
    "next_steps": ["Redacted feedback or confirmation"]
  },
  "reason_codes": ["POST_MERGE_ALIGNED|POST_MERGE_MISALIGNED|POST_MERGE_EVIDENCE_GAP|POST_MERGE_CONTRACT_INVALID"],
  "notes": "Concise human-readable rationale"
}

Rules:
- If disposition=approve, recommended_transition must be close_milestone.
- If disposition=reject, recommended_transition must be open_followup.
- If disposition=defer, recommended_transition must be request_more_evidence.
- If disposition=escalate, recommended_transition must be escalate_contract.
- reason_codes must be non-empty.
Return JSON only.
